MediaPipe Tasks Vision 0.10.32 and Pose Landmarker Lite, Full and Heavy float16 v1
Copyright Google LLC. Licensed under Apache License 2.0.
Sources: https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe
https://ai.google.dev/edge/mediapipe/solutions/vision/pose_landmarker

All three unmodified Pose Landmarker task bundles use the same Tasks Vision
runtime and output 33 image landmarks and 33 estimated world landmarks.

Unmodified runtime and model assets are served locally. Pinned download URLs,
npm integrity and SHA-256 hashes are recorded in manifest.json. Restore and
verify with scripts/setup-motion-assets.mjs (or --verify).
